name: dev_browser_action
description: Operate the current caller's private V3 development browser: navigate, read rendered text, measure element sizes and positions, sample rendered pixel colours, read page-load timing, wait for and time conditions, inspect animations, scroll, click, type, press keys, emulate phone/desktop and dark mode, and take screenshots that attach to the reply
retry_hint: read the page again to see whether the earlier click or typing already took effect; every click or type needs its own fresh read, so input cannot repeat blindly

selector.description: CSS selector. read/measure/animations/wait_for: every match. click/type/press: the target, inside the region your last read covered. scroll: element to bring into view or whose scroll container to scroll. pixels: sample the centre of the first rendered match

text.description: type: literal text to type. wait_for condition text: the text to wait for

preset.description: viewport only: phone 390x844, phone_small 360x640 and tablet 768x1024 emulate touch devices; desktop 1280x900, desktop_wide 1440x900; navigate again afterwards

offset.description: read: character offset; measure: element offset. Use next_offset from the previous result

condition.description: wait_for only: visible/hidden need selector; text needs text; quiet waits until the page stops changing for quiet_ms; animations_done ignores endless animations; network_idle waits until no request finished for quiet_ms

timeout_ms.description: wait_for only: give up after this long (default 5000)

quiet_ms.description: wait_for quiet/network_idle: how long it must stay still (default 500)

key.description: press only: sent to selector, or to the focused element

styles.description: measure only: include computed CSS for each element (5 elements per call)

points.description: pixels only: viewport points in CSS px
